payload.claim: NordVPN unblocked all 14 streaming services tested
payload.quote: NordVPN unblocked all 14 services we tried, a result only ExpressVPN matched.

payload.claim: NordVPN US server tested 181.50 of 190.36 Mbps, the fastest US result recorded
payload.quote: Its US server tested at 181.50 Mbps on our 190.36 Mbps connection, the fastest US result we recorded.
The average speed loss across UK, US, and Japanese servers was 7.8%, which leaves far more speed than 4K requires.

payload.claim: NordVPN, ExpressVPN and Mullvad were the fastest providers in Comparitech tests
payload.quote: Mullvad VPN, NordVPN, and ExpressVPN were the fastest providers this quarter.

payload.claim: NordVPN no-log policy backed by six independent audits since 2018
payload.quote: Six independent audits since 2018 back its no-log policy.

payload.claim: NordVPN Basic under 3.50 per month on two-year term
payload.quote: The Basic plan is under $3.50 a month on a two-year term.

payload.claim: Proton VPN unblocked 10 of 14 services but not Hulu, Pluto TV or ITVX
payload.quote: It couldn’t unblock Hulu, Pluto TV, or ITVX, so if those are your main services, choose NordVPN instead.

payload.claim: Proton VPN Plus under 3 per month on two-year term
payload.quote: On a two-year term, the VPN Plus plan costs under $3 a month and covers 10 devices.

payload.claim: Proton VPN passed a fifth consecutive annual independent no-logs audit by Securitum
payload.quote: Conducted by leading European security firm Securitum, the latest independent audit confirmed that the provider strictly adheres to its no-logs policy.

payload.claim: Proton audit was a point-in-time review of selected servers, not a continuous guarantee
payload.quote: The engagement covered selected production server samples rather than Proton’s entire global VPN network, and conclusions were based on the systems, documentation, and evidence made available during the assessment period.
Its average speed loss was 10.2%, and VPN Accelerator, which improves speed on long-distance connections, is enabled by default and made its US server 4.9% faster.

payload.claim: Proton VPN has highest latency to EU servers and noticeable lag when busy
payload.quote: Proton VPN keeps a decent portion of the connection speed to UK servers but has the highest latency to EU servers and noticeable lag when busy.

payload.claim: ExpressVPN no-log policy independently audited; Basic under 3 on 28-month term
payload.quote: Its no-log policy is independently audited, and the Basic plan costs under $3 a month on a 28-month term.

payload.claim: Surfshark no-log policy audited by Deloitte in 2023 and 2025
payload.quote: Camouflage Mode disguises VPN traffic on restrictive networks, CleanWeb strips ads from streaming sites, and Deloitte audited the no-log policy in 2023 and 2025.

payload.claim: DuckDuckGo VPN lacks streaming-optimized servers and costs 9.99/month
payload.quote: It lacks multi-hop routing, split tunneling, dedicated IP addresses, and streaming-optimized servers, all of which are common in VPNs like NordVPN or Surfshark.

payload.claim: PrivadoVPN has not undergone an independent audit
payload.quote: Our testing concluded that PrivadoVPN covered all the privacy basics well, but unlike many of the better-known providers, it has not undergone an independent audit of its privacy policy, apps, or server infrastructure.

payload.claim: IPVanish completed third independent no-logs audit by Schellman in Sept 2026
payload.quote: The audit was completed by Schellman Compliance, a leading provider of attestation services, on September 25, 2026.

payload.claim: Most VPNs renew at two to three times introductory rate
payload.quote: Once the first term ends, most VPNs renew at two to three times the introductory monthly rate.
